## Log-transform expression

```{r}
expr_clean <- readr::read_tsv(
  "../data/02_dat_clean.tsv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

expr_aug <- expr_clean |>
  dplyr::mutate(log2_expr = log2(expression + 1))
```
## Derive developmental age and age group

```{r}
expr_aug <- expr_aug |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    age_years = 10^log_age - 0.7,
    age_group = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(age_years) ~ NA_character_,
      age_years < 0 ~ "Prenatal",
      age_years < 2 ~ "Infant",
      age_years < 12 ~ "Child",
      age_years < 20 ~ "Adolescent",
      TRUE ~ "Adult"
    ),
    age_group = factor(
      age_group,
      levels = c("Prenatal", "Infant", "Child", "Adolescent", "Adult")
    )
  )
```
## Save augmented data

```{r}
readr::write_tsv(expr_aug, "../data/03_dat_aug.tsv")
```
